name: habit-tracker
description: A modern full-stack habit tracker with GitHub-style activity heatmaps, streak analytics, achievements, and milestone celebrations.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/api
